text: In the weeks before the crime
why: The story gives no date for the lameness. The lad says only 'of late', which does not establish 'weeks before the crime'.
A plain question raised by the lad's report of lame sheep and Holmes's interest in it.

text: What lamed the sheep? — an epidemic or chance
why: Epidemic or chance are ordinary, general explanations for lameness that a reader could reasonably consider without any story-specific hint.

text: What lamed the sheep? — someone practised on them
why: Deliberate tampering with the sheep is not suggested anywhere in the story so far. Holmes's question is only about whether anything is amiss, so this possibility has no basis yet.
